t: Fortress Trade 12" Roller Tray Liners are transparent plastic inserts specifically designed for use with compatible 12" paint roller trays. Ideal for painters, decorators, and DIY enthusiasts undertaking light duty painting tasks, these liners provide a convenient and clean solution for various projects. Manufactured from durable polyethylene terephthalate (PET) plastic, they offer a disposable option that simplifies clean-up and extends the life of paint roller trays. The transparent design allows for easy monitoring of paint levels during application, ensuring efficient work on site or at home.
b: Durable PET Plastic Construction for Reliability
Transparent Material For Clear Paint Level Monitoring
